== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}

Jesse was born in 1838. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3823|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-3824|Elizabeth Glasgow]].


== Research Notes ==

That repeat association strengthens the paternal inference beyond one isolated list.

Selected Glasgow-3823 fatherhood of Glasgow-3829; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.
